effects: Replaces the signer's whole claim executor list with the given addresses; old executors lose the right to claim for the signer.
Each listed executor gains the right to claim the signer's FTSO and airdrop rewards and send them to the signer, the signer's delegation account or an allowed recipient.
Sends each newly added registered executor its current fee in SGB from msg.value; the fee rate comes from storage.
Refunds the rest of msg.value to the signer; reverts if msg.value is below the total fee.
formats.shown: Intent 'Set claim executors', each executor address, and the SGB sent as 'Max executor fees, excess refunded'.

findings.title: setClaimExecutors pays each new executor a fee read from storage; only the total maximum is shown.
findings.evidence: ClaimSetupManager._setClaimExecutors: `uint256 executorFee = getExecutorCurrentFeeValue(executor); ... executor.call{value: executorFee}("")`. Descriptor shows only `@.value` 'Max executor fees, excess refunded'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the per-executor fee; the cap label is the best available.

findings.title: setClaimExecutors replaces the whole executor list; an empty list removes all executors and shows no field.
findings.fix: Consider the intent 'Replace claim executors' so the signer knows old executors are removed.

effects: Replaces the signer's whole allowed claim recipient list.
Executors of the signer can then send the signer's claimed rewards to any of these addresses.
formats.shown: Intent 'Set allowed claim recipients' and each recipient address.

findings.title: setAllowedClaimRecipients does not say that executors may send the signer's rewards to these addresses.
findings.evidence: ClaimSetupManager.checkExecutorAndAllowedRecipient: `ownerAllowedClaimRecipientSet[_claimFor].index[_recipient] != 0` lets an executor send claimed rewards there. Intent 'Set allowed claim recipients'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Let executors send your rewards to' and label the field 'Reward recipients'.

effects: Replaces the signer's whole claim executor list and gives the listed executors the right to claim rewards for the signer.
Pays each newly added registered executor its current fee in SGB from msg.value and refunds the rest to the signer.
When the flag is true, creates or enables the signer's personal delegation account, so auto-claimed rewards go to that account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Enable automatic claiming', executor addresses, 'Delegation Account' as raw true/false, and the SGB sent as 'Max executor fees, excess refunded'.

findings.title: setAutoClaiming shows the delegation account flag as raw 'true' under the vague label 'Delegation Account'.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `#._enableDelegationAccount` label 'Delegation Account' format 'raw'; case 2 renders 'Delegation Account: true'. Code: `if (_enableDelegationAccount) { _createOrEnableDelegationAccount(); }`.
findings.fix: Label the field 'Enable delegation account (rewards go there)' or use an enum mapping true/false to 'Yes, send rewards to delegation account'/'No change'.

findings.title: setAutoClaiming pays each new executor a fee read from storage; only the total maximum is shown.

effects: Creates the signer's personal delegation account if none exists, and enables it.
Future auto-claimed FTSO and airdrop rewards go to the delegation account instead of the signer's wallet.
Disables the signer's delegation account, so auto-claimed rewards go to the signer's wallet.
Withdraws the whole WSGB balance of the delegation account to the signer (via the delegation account code).
formats.shown: Intent 'Disable delegation account, withdraw WSGB', no fields.

findings.title: disableDelegationAccount withdraws the whole WSGB balance read from storage; no amount can be shown.
findings.fix: Optionally change the intent to 'Disable delegation account, withdraw all WSGB'.

effects: Moves _amount WSGB from the signer's delegation account to the signer's wallet (via the delegation account code).

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw funds' names neither WSGB nor the delegation account as the source.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Withdraw WSGB from delegation account'.

effects: Moves _amount of _token (not WSGB) from the signer's delegation account to the signer's wallet (via the delegation account code).
formats.shown: Intent 'Recover external token', the token and the amount in that token.

findings.title: transferExternalToken intent does not say tokens move from the delegation account to the signer.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Withdraw token from delegation account'.

effects: Sets the FTSO delegation of the signer's delegation account WSGB to _to at _bips basis points, replacing the previous share for _to.
A share of 0 revokes the delegation to _to.
formats.shown: Intent 'Set FTSO delegation share', the provider address and the share in %.

findings.title: delegate changes the delegation account's vote power, but nothing says it is not the wallet's own WSGB.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Set delegation account FTSO share'.

findings.title: delegate shows a share of 0 as '0%' without saying it revokes the delegation.
findings.evidence: Devdoc delegate `_bips`: 'value of 0 revokes delegation'. Field 'Share' unit decimals 2 base '%'.
findings.fix: Add a message for 0, or label the field 'Share (0 = revoke)'.

effects: Revokes every existing FTSO delegation of the signer's delegation account.
Delegates each listed share of the delegation account's vote power to the paired provider.
formats.shown: Intent 'Replace all FTSO delegations' and provider/share pairs.

findings.title: batchDelegate does not say the delegations replaced belong to the delegation account, not the wallet.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Replace delegation account FTSO delegations'.

effects: Revokes all FTSO delegations of the signer's delegation account.
formats.shown: Intent 'Undelegate FTSO vote power', no fields.

findings.title: undelegateAll intent omits that all delegations go and that they are the delegation account's.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Remove all delegation account FTSO delegations'.

effects: Revokes the delegation account's delegation to _who for vote power reads at a past block _blockNumber.
formats.shown: Intent 'Revoke delegation at block', 'Who' address and raw block number.

findings.title: revokeDelegationAt labels the delegate 'Who' and omits that the delegation account is affected.
findings.fix: Label the field 'Delegate' and change the intent to 'Revoke past delegation account vote'.

effects: Delegates all governance vote power of the signer's delegation account to _to, replacing any previous governance delegate.

findings.title: delegateGovernance does not say it delegates the delegation account's vote power, all of it.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Delegate account governance votes' and label the field 'Delegate'.

effects: Removes the governance delegation of the signer's delegation account.
Burns exactly registerExecutorFeeValueWei (1000 SGB at deploy) of the signer's SGB by sending it to 0x...dEaD.
Registers the signer as a claim executor.
Sets the signer's executor fee to _feeValue SGB now, or schedules it after the update offset if the signer was registered recently.
formats.shown: Intent 'Register as claim executor', 'Executor Fee' in SGB and 'Registration fee (burned)' in SGB.

findings.title: registerExecutor may schedule the fee for a later epoch, decided by storage; the screen cannot show which.

effects: Schedules the signer's executor fee to _feeValue SGB from current epoch plus the update offset (3 epochs).
formats.shown: Intent 'Schedule executor fee update' and 'Fee Value' in SGB.

findings.title: updateExecutorFeeValue labels the field 'Fee Value'; it does not say it is the per-claim executor fee.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `#._feeValue` label 'Fee Value'; sibling registerExecutor uses 'Executor Fee'.

effects: Removes the signer from the registered executors.
Schedules the signer's executor fee to 0 after the update offset; the burned registration fee is not returned.
formats.shown: Intent 'Unregister as claim executor', no fields.
